reusable_lessons: Parse scene keys at the final underscore. Instance suffixes are not persistent identities.
Scene Z is category-nominal. Height changes, disappearance, and primitive completion do not establish grasp or delivery.
Only an explicit no_collision_free_path result establishes zero execution. Stop after other execution uncertainty.
Keep the gripper closed during carrying and preserve its command when uncertain execution prevents safe continuation.
Reassociate baskets spatially and refresh object observations after completed release and withdrawal.
Task progress may require more than six manipulation cycles; use a finite larger bound and spatially bounded retries.
development_changes_to_evaluate: Target nominal object centre plus the documented contact offset instead of adding another half-height.
Allow stationary closing before lift and stationary opening before withdrawal.
Transport above the estimated basket rim, then descend separately to the documented release height.
Replace fixed destination offsets with dimension-constrained interior locations, preferring separation from visible occupants.
Use global category-to-basket assignment minimizing relocations before travel.

rationale: This policy addresses the reported failure modes without treating development observations as hidden-state inputs. It changes top-surface grasp targeting to nominal centre-depth targeting, adds bounded stationary gripper settling, separates rim-clearing transport from low release, and removes unconditional destination offsets. Placement candidates remain inside observed basket geometry and account for visible occupants. A small assignment optimizer reduces unnecessary moves, while fresh RGB reassociation and bounded retries support tasks exceeding six objects. Explicit no-path rejections permit limited alternatives; uncertain execution ends the policy without speculative manipulation. These are proposed repairs for independent evaluation, not evidence of task success.
